statement: storyboard 权威采用短滚动商业产品路线：从完全爆炸首帧开始，依次完成精密合体、球体核心展示、结尾剖面和清水流动；叙事重点是商业级工业摄影中的结构可靠感，而不是维修教程或随机 CAD 爆炸。

shot_order.cognition: all major valve systems are already separated and readable
the separated components assemble into a precise fixed ball valve
the polished ball core becomes the calm visual and functional center
a controlled cutaway reveals the internal flow path without becoming a repair diagram
clean water flow and final commercial hero hold communicate clarity and product confidence

story_rhythm_policy.secondary_motion: ball core presentation, cutaway reveal and clean water flow
story_rhythm_policy.short_scroll_density_policy: one readable product idea at a time; do not force a full disassembly and reassembly cycle into the same short scroll

forbidden: assembled first frame in the current short-scroll route
explode then reassemble round trip in the current short-scroll route
real assembly or repair procedure claim
opaque liquid or dirty fluid as product proof
unsupported pressure, certification, material-grade, maintenance, service-life, fire-safe, anti-static, leakage or performance claims
